name: mastery-tutor
description: Codex adapter for Mastery Tutor: guided HTML lessons, hands-on practice, transfer checks, spaced review, and learner-owned local progress.

interface.shortDescription: Guided lessons, hands-on practice, and local progress.
interface.longDescription: This adapter loads the portable Mastery Tutor Agent Skills into Codex. Tell it what you want to learn and how much time you have. It plans a route, opens each teaching turn in a local HTML classroom, prepares exercises and interactive labs, checks independent work and later recall, and resumes from learner-owned progress in a new task.
defaultPrompt: Help me learn this topic from my current level.
Continue from my saved progress and start with anything due for review.
Turn this concept into a guided lesson with a hands-on exercise.
